title: Making What Matters: Chris Lins

## Making What Matters: Chris Lins


Solving challenges and helping customers succeed are top priorities at Graco. Employees across the organization come to work each day focused on helping customers complete their jobs more efficiently.


One of these employees is Chris Lins, senior engineering manager in Graco’s Contractor Division. For over 27 years with the company, Lins has earned close to 200 patents and contributed to several product advancements. His work has helped improve products and deliver meaningful benefits for customers.


#### A passion for solving problems


Lins always excelled in subjects such as science and math, but those skills were not the main reason he pursued engineering. Growing up on a farm, he spent much of his time fixing things and solving problems.


By combining his love for tinkering with his academic strengths, Lins decided to pursue a career in engineering. That decision led him to a long and successful career at Graco, where he continues to help solve customer challenges through innovation.


#### Evolving the Magnum paint sprayer


One of Lins’ first projects at Graco involved the[Magnum® paint sprayer](https://www.graco.com/us/en/contractor/products/architectural-painting-coating/paint-sprayers/magnum.html) . Lins worked with other teams within the company to design a single-turn knob on the side of the sprayer to adjust the pressure.


“Ideas can come from everywhere,” said Lins. “Everything is a group effort. It doesn’t matter who is on the team. What matters is that there’s a problem to solve and we solve it together.”


The feature Lins helped implement in the early 2000s can still be seen on the Magnum paint sprayer, with minor refinements made over the years. For Lins, it is rewarding to see parts of his work continue to live on through newer generations of the product.


#### Involvement with ProConnect


Although he was not the original creator of ProConnect®, Lins has played a role in several iterations of the ProConnect pump, ProXChange pump technology and ProConnect gun cartridges. These innovations, used across select Graco contractor equipment, help reduce downtime and maintenance.


“I take the most pride in being a part of projects that enable contractors to maintain their own equipment and keep it operating without having to rely on service centers,” said Lins.


#### From engineer to manager


Lins’ career at Graco has evolved from an engineering role into management, but his passion for problem-solving remains unchanged. Today, he supports the engineering team in a different capacity, using his experience and technical expertise to guide projects and mentor engineers.


His leadership role also provides more opportunities to interact directly with customers. Lins has encouraged greater customer engagement among his team, including participation in field testing activities where engineers can connect directly with contractors, gather feedback and help address challenges firsthand.


#### Don’t be afraid to fail


When asked what advice he would offer aspiring engineers, Lins emphasized the importance of trying new things and not being afraid to fail.


“It is okay to try something and fail,” said Lins. “You don’t have to be right right away.”


Lins believes innovation requires curiosity, experimentation and a willingness to test ideas that may not yet exist. Just as importantly, he said, engineers must first understand the problem they are trying to solve before developing solutions.


[Learn more](https://www.graco.com/us/en/contractor/products.html) about the products that Lins and other members of the Contractor Division develop to help solve customer challenges.
